leadText:
POKÉTOON: The Pokémon Cartoon Animation (Japanese: ポケモンアニメシリーズ「 」 Pokémon Anime Series "POKÉTOON"), also known as POKÉTOON shorts or simply POKÉTOON, is a series of shorts featuring various originally posted on the Japanese Pokémon Kids TV channel on YouTube. The series has an format and none of its episodes apparently follow a chronological line.

The first short, Scraggy and Mimikyu, was released on June 5, 2020. Nearly a year later, the second short, The Pancham Who Wants to Be a Hero, was released on May 5, 2021. Four additional shorts were announced on May 10, 2021, with a total of six shorts being released from June 4 to December 28, 2021. The English dub of the shorts were released on Pokémon TV every Friday from June 17, 2022 to August 5, 2022, and were later released on the English Pokémon YouTube channel on August 25, 2022.

A second season of eight shorts was released on the official Japanese Pokémon YouTube channel and other accounts every Wednesday from September 18 to November 6, 2024. Unlike the earlier series, these shorts have a more musical element. Four of the shorts are in a vertical format, while the other four are in the traditional horizontal format and feature original ending themes by Fukurow note, Taiyu Fujiwara, LustQueen, and RUI・TAIKI・KANON. An additional ninth short was released on February 14, 2025.

A third season of shorts was announced on June 13, 2025, with the first short being released on the Japanese YouTube channel on October 4, 2025, and on the English YouTube channel on October 24, 2025.
